notes: «- المعنى واحد -» is an editor gloss and left out; «قال عبد هو ابن عباد» is the transmitter's gloss identifying يحيى, not a new link, so it is left out
Abu Talib, the Quraysh and Abu Jahl are in the scene, not links; Ibn Abbas is the last link
the closing «قال أبو عيسى هذا حديث حسن صحيح» is the compiler's grading, not part of the chain
